title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.4
subtitle: Consistent Sewing Strength for intra- and cross-object seams.

highlights.title: Strength per seam
highlights.description: Intra-object seams now use their own Strength value, matching the cross-object workflow.

highlights.title: Firmer Sewing by default
highlights.description: New seams start at Strength 100, calibrated for firm closure. Existing seam values are preserved; set them to 100 and rebake to use the new setting.

highlights.title: Shared dynamic stitch export
highlights.description: Intra- and cross-object seams use the same solver representation, including single-object bakes. Strength 0 omits the seam.
